answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its attestations count, and peers check that bond when scoring work. A swarm of 100 fakes must freeze 50,000 tokens and wait ten epochs, so faking influence costs real capital and time. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help: each wallet still posts a full bond, and bonds funded from one source in the same block are flagged. An honest agent that logs sparrow counts on a knoll beside a lagoon pays the bond once and gets it back after probation.
